name: Chromium History
category: web browser (history, omnibox, NTP most visited)
param_style: ? positional via sql::Statement Bind*(0-based index); a few statements built with StrCat/StringPrintf
schema_source: CREATE TABLE/INDEX string literals in url_database.cc, visit_database.cc, visitsegment_database.cc, visit_annotations_database.cc, shortcuts_database.cc, top_sites_database.cc, reassembled
data_scale: scale 1: 800 hosts, 30k urls, 150k visits (+135k context annotations, 38k visit_source), ~1.1k keyword search terms, 2k segments / 27k segment_usage, 3.5k clusters / 28k cluster visits, 3k shortcuts, 20 top sites (~34 MB)
visibility_note: Chrome's History database runs on billions of installs; the urls/visits schema is also inherited by Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and other Chromium browsers
interest_note: Omnibox prefix range scans with top-N on three keys, substr()-based prefix-of matching, history page queries with stacked LEFT JOINs (visit_source, context_annotations 404 filter) and runtime-built WHERE, LIKE with _ wildcards, IN-subquery index rebuilds, GROUP BY/HAVING MAX journeys ranking, transition bitmask predicates.
reach_note: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and others share this History DB code; billions of installs
